summary: The filing is a Form 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share declared by the board of John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. The dividend is payable June 3, 2026 to holders of record May 13, 2026, with aggregate payment of ~$1.3 million. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activism, tender, or restructuring is involved. The filing solely reports a standard dividend declaration, making it ineligible for any special-situations category.
